excluded_constructs_stated_by_syllabus.verbatim: The resource use does not req uire specific local or regional knowledge.
Whilst specific questions will not be set in Paper 1 based upon fie ld work, learners may use this information to illustrate answers.
This paper will be largely skills-based and candidates will not require knowledge of specific places, but will be expected to apply some knowledge of topics.
One question will be specifically based on a large -scale (1:50 000) topographical map, with full colour map from any country in SADC. The map will always be presented with a full key.
Cross -sections may be set for interpre tation but learners will not be asked to construct them.
It should be noted that both measurements must be made in the sam e units before the calculation can be made.
It must be stressed that all answers to this question must be based on map evidence only.

depth_constraints.excluded_constructs_source: excluded_constructs are the limits the syllabus states anywhere in the subject, each as the pattern C-11 scans learner-facing text for (curriculum/scope-scan.json): the sentence is Cambridge’s, the pattern is our judgement of what teaching past it looks like, and any match fails the topic. adjacent_topics are not scanned: they name subject matter a neighbouring topic owns. Naming one in passing is fine and often necessary; teaching it here is scope creep.
